data.primary.conf:
dir /data
# User-supplied primary configuration:
rename-command FLUSHDB ""
rename-command FLUSHALL ""
# End of primary configuration
data.replica.conf:
dir /data
# User-supplied replica configuration:
rename-command FLUSHDB ""
rename-command FLUSHALL ""
# End of replica configuration
data.sentinel.conf:
dir "/tmp"
port 26379
sentinel monitor myprimary valkey-node-0.valkey-headless.default.svc.cluster.local 6379 2
sentinel down-after-milliseconds myprimary 60000
sentinel failover-timeout myprimary 180000
sentinel parallel-syncs myprimary 1
# User-supplied sentinel configuration:

# End of sentinel configuration
data.valkey.conf:
# User-supplied common configuration:
# Enable AOF https://valkey.io/docs/topics/persistence.html
appendonly yes
# Disable RDB persistence, AOF persistence already enabled.
save ""
# End of common configuration
